name: parts
description: AI-authored 2D character parts from one painting: See-through layers assembled into rig-ready PNGs and a weighted-mesh rig spec that rig-c compiles and verifies before anything is written.

paragraphs: AI-authored 2D character rigs from one anime painting, verified before they are written. rig-parts takes a single character painting and the layers See-through decomposed it into, merges them into measured rig-space parts, authors weighted meshes, bone chains and a looping idle over them in rig-c's spec, and hands that spec to rig-c to compile, gate, pack, render and check. It is built for agents that cannot see the image: every stage prints named, numeric findings, a refusal names the object, the value found and the value required, nothing is written after a red, and no value is invented…
